caption: The drawing features a central, intricate blue ornamental design resembling an elaborate, symmetrical lyre or harp motif with decorative swirls, lines, and rounded edges. The main motif is shaded and textured, showing careful attention to detail, with circular elements at the base and scroll-like forms on either side, plus a vertical central form flanked by symmetric patterns. Above and to the right of the main motif, there is a smaller, square inset of a similar blue ornamental design—a simplified lyre-like pattern with two scrolls at the sides, dots in the middle, and a triangular base, set on a crosshatched background. Both motifs are rendered in shades of blue ink or pencil. The objects are centered on a mostly empty, yellowed paper with a rectangular border sketched around them. Near the bottom right corner of the bordered area, the name “John Thirantino” is written in small, neat block letters. There are faint smudges and patches of discoloration elsewhere on the page.
title: Salt Cellar
